CustomField.label: Attendance Day
CustomField.description: The rolled-up day this punch belongs to. Stamped by AttendanceRollupService after the day is derived, never entered by hand. A lookup rather than a master-detail on purpose: the day is derived from the punches, so it must not own them. A master-detail would cascade-delete the punches whenever the rollup removed a day, destroying the very records the day was calculated from.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically. The attendance day these punches roll up into.
